anchor: Phase 1 seed for the commuter + tourism + anomaly-tag framework. See docs/strategy/2026-05-25-COMMUTER-TOURISM-NEIGHBORHOOD-FRAMEWORK.md for the full spec. Keyed by city_slug.neighborhood_slug. Numbers are approximations from public stats offices (US LEHD, UK ONS, FR INSEE Mobilités) plus city tourism boards (NYCgo, Visit London, Atout France). Refresh annually.

convention.tags: array of anomaly tags from the 13-tag system
convention.primary_tag: the most decision-relevant tag for badge display
convention.source_quality: A = block-level stats, B = district-level, C = estimate from city tier

tag_definitions.financial_cbd: Banking + corporate HQ density; lunch + B2B services dominate
tag_definitions.luxury_district: Median household wealth top decile + retail rent top 5%
tag_definitions.tech_corridor: Software/IT payroll density + high tertiary education
tag_definitions.nightlife_zone: Bar + club density top 5%, weekend foot 2x weekday
tag_definitions.religious_pilgrimage: Annual pilgrim count > 100K AND > 10x resident pop

new-york.manhattan.notes: Composite — Manhattan as a whole. Real intra-borough variance is huge (FiDi 6.2 vs Harlem 0.7). Future v2 splits into 4-6 sub-zones.

new-york.brooklyn.notes: Williamsburg + DUMBO gentrifying; Bushwick + Brownsville pure residential.

new-york.queens.notes: JFK + LaGuardia drive transit_hub tag; Astoria is gentrifying but smaller share of borough.

london.central-london.notes: City of London + Westminster + Camden. The City alone has commuter_intensity ~8.

london.north-london.notes: Islington + Camden Town + Hampstead — creative + residential mix.

london.east-london.notes: Shoreditch + Hackney + Stratford — Tech City + Olympic regeneration.

london.west-london.notes: Kensington + Chelsea + Mayfair — premium residential, embassies, designer retail.

paris.right-bank-central.notes: 1st-4th arrondissements - Louvre, Marais, Les Halles. Louvre alone draws 9M tourists/year.

paris.north-periphery.notes: 18th-20th arrondissements - Montmartre tourism in 18th but mostly residential.
